label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2 rewarded), only in the last trials of the episode
explanation: The feature fires only at D1, the step where the previous trial reward is shown. 95% of activation mass has in_rew = 1, and 94% follows a previous trial where the agent chose a1 and had a rare transition to S2 (prev_common = 0, prev_action = 1). So it fires on the rare-rewarded a1 case, where a model-based agent should switch to a2, and the next choice is in fact usually a switch (stay = 0, lift 9.6x). It is also strongly gated by episode time: 99.8% of activations fall in episode trials 90-99, it never fires before trial 80, and all activations sit in the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.2, which also happens near the episode end). The base condition alone has precision 0.05. Adding ep_trial >= 93 gives dev F1 0.70 and mass recall 0.86, precision 0.73. Raising the threshold increases precision (0.96 at >= 97) but loses recall, so magnitude seems to rise as the episode end approaches. Adding the upcoming switch to a2 or a longer a1 history did not help. The weak misses (activation about 0.1-0.3) are D1 steps with other rewarded or unrewarded histories late in the episode. It never fires at GO or D2, after rewarded a2 or common transitions (except weakly), or before trial 80. Every variable in the predicate is observed (ep_trial is time in the episode).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, ?) and value (model) (D1: decile 0 (9 ); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=GO & ep_dec=0.
